# Image

An approved image from the asset library, placed by its register id, with the register’s alt text.

Include `gg/image.html` · Formats: web, flyer, postcard, social · Decisions: D-053 · Rules: IMG-001, IMG-002, IMG-004 · Reads site data: `assets.items`

The contract is `_data/components/image.yml` (COMP-002). Sources are explained in [Components](../../brand/system/components.md).

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Source | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | asset | yes |  | assets | The register’s asset_id. Only approved rows with known rights render. |
| `decorative` | bool | no | false | request | True when the text beside the image already says what it shows; gives empty alt (IMG-002). |
